feature_definition.source: The immediately preceding draw's six main numbers only; bonus is excluded.
feature_definition.distance: Minimum absolute numeric distance from candidate n to any of the previous draw's six main numbers; no circular wrap.

bins.0: distance exactly 0 (number is one of the previous six main numbers)

feature_definition.candidate_universe: All integers 1..45 are assigned to exactly one bin for each target.

estimator.conditional_exposure: For each historical transition and candidate number, increment the exposure for the candidate's distance bin relative to the previous draw's six main numbers.
estimator.conditional_hits: Increment the matching bin/number hit count when that candidate is in the following draw's six main numbers.
estimator.global_rate: Count of each main number in draws 1..t-1 divided by t-1.

portfolio.line_assignment: Deterministic rank interleaving: line 1 uses ranks 1,4,7,10,13,16; line 2 uses ranks 2,5,8,11,14,17; line 3 uses ranks 3,6,9,12,15,18.
portfolio.geometry: Exactly three pairwise-disjoint six-number lines, union18.

random_comparator.method: For each target, uniformly permute labels 1..45 jointly over the three fixed model lines, preserving three six-number lines, pairwise disjointness, union18, and line incidence geometry.

inference.ci_method: Two-sided percentile moving-block bootstrap of per-target differences from the exact geometry-matched union18 null.
